text: Completed the ASC line-accounting, fuzz, and corruption court. Published AscLineAccounting proves each nonblank physical line is exactly typed, preserved-unknown, or rejected with valid unique source locations; comments are typed and only lexical blanks are exempt. Deterministic ScalaCheck court uses seed 0x4559454c494e4b, 400 successful cases per property, and varies token classes, whitespace, field counts, hostile numeric forms, eye/layout declarations, boundaries, messages, truncation, LF/CRLF, and arbitrary stream chunking. Deterministic fixtures cover huge lines/lone CR recovery, near-limit operands, nonfinite and ordering failures, missing END, malformed pairs, and converter failsafe output. All public diagnostic excerpts are bounded to 160 characters while exact raw inputs remain available. Mutation Unknown->TypedRecord was killed on JVM and Scala.js and restored. Final gates: ioJVM 131/131, ioJS 117/117, both scalafmt checks, git diff --check, and checkBoundaries all green.
